description: This file defines the FISClient class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with the AWS Fault Injection Simulator (FIS) service. It provides method annotations for synchronous and asynchronous operations related to FIS resources and extends the base AwsClient class.

classes.name: FISClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS Fault Injection Simulator (FIS) service, providing methods for managing experiments, targets, configurations, and other FIS resources.

methods.name: createExperimentTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new experiment template for FIS.

methods.name: createExperimentTemplateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new experiment template.

methods.name: createTargetAccountConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a target account configuration for FIS.

methods.name: createTargetAccountConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a target account configuration.

methods.name: deleteTargetAccountConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a target account configuration.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific FIS action.

methods.name: getActionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a specific FIS action.

methods.name: getExperiment
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific experiment.

methods.name: getExperimentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a specific experiment.

methods.name: getExperimentTargetAccountConfiguration
methods.description: Gets the target account configuration for an experiment.

methods.name: getExperimentTargetAccountConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets the target account configuration for an experiment.

methods.name: getExperimentTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves details of an experiment template.

methods.name: getExperimentTemplateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of an experiment template.

methods.name: getSafetyLever
methods.description: Gets the safety lever state for an experiment.

methods.name: getSafetyLeverAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets the safety lever state.

methods.name: getTargetResourceType
methods.description: Returns details about a specific target resource type.

methods.name: getTargetResourceTypeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves target resource type details.

methods.name: listExperimentResolvedTargets
methods.description: Lists resolved targets for an experiment.

methods.name: listExperimentTargetAccountConfigurations
methods.description: Lists target account configurations for experiments.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateSafetyLeverStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the safety lever state.

methods.name: updateTargetAccountConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the target account configuration.
